prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for low-speed head-on collision. Insured reports other vehicle crossed center line on a two-lane road. No airbags deployed. Both vehicles driveable from scene. Photos requested from insured and police report ordered.

Entry 2: Claimant's shoulder injury reported through counsel. Letter of representation received and logged. All further contact to go through claimant's attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and prior treatment records for the shoulder.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report. Responding officer cited other driver for lane violation. Scene diagram consistent with insured's account. Liability appears clear at this stage, pending review of vehicle damage estimates.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's counsel's paralegal regarding treatment status. Claimant has completed initial evaluation and is scheduled for imaging. Demand package not yet received. Diary set for follow-up in two weeks.

Entry 5: Reviewed repair estimates for both vehicles and property damage file. Medical records still outstanding from treating provider. Sent reminder request to counsel's office. Reserves reviewed and left at current levels until records are received.
